notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Wildwood Scourge.
Any creature type except "Hydra" or "Frog" chosen with Conspiracy.
description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying {1}{G}{U}, creating a token copy of Wildwood Scourge that is a 1/1 Frog.
Put a +1/+1 counter on either Wildwood Scourge.
The Wildwood Scourge who didn't have the counter put on it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat step 3.
